The '''Neona system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], on the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
